name: casid
description: Casid — Verified Economic Event Fabric for Flare

scripts.dev:all: bun run --filter @casid/coordinator dev & bun run --filter @casid/web dev
scripts.build: bun run --filter @casid/core build && bun run --filter @casid/web build && bun run --filter @casid/coordinator build
scripts.deploy:local: cd contracts && forge script script/DeployLocal.s.sol --fork-url http://127.0.0.1:8545 --broadcast -vvv
scripts.test: bun run --filter @casid/core build && bun run --filter @casid/core test && bun run --filter @casid/coordinator test && cd contracts && forge test
